task: Bug: environment variables are documented as the highest-priority configuration source, but a value from settings.json currently overwrites SERVICE_TIMEOUT from the environment. Fix precedence without changing defaults, parsing, tests, or example configuration. Existing tests may not cover the reported combination. Validate the repository and inspect the final diff.
validation_command: python -m unittest discover -v && SERVICE_TIMEOUT=45 python -c "from app.config import load_settings; assert load_settings('settings.json').timeout == 45"
expected_behavior: Environment overrides are applied after file values, while defaults and file-only configuration still work.
